source: b8-glm batch L3 occiai-r1, stage_2 call_3_coordination: coordination link CL-7 as the reply wrote it (control-structure.yaml), whose description names PM-3 and PM-4 although the real IDs are PM-3-1 to PM-3-4 and PM-4-1 to PM-4-4. Every synthesis routing prompt then failed the prompt-reference check. Trimmed to CL-7, constraint SC-8 and hazard H-9 that the description cites, and the IDs the link needs: RESP-3 keeps PM-3-1 and PM-3-2, RESP-4 keeps only its shared PM-4-3. The texts of records other than CL-7 are shortened.

use_case_losses.description: Unreviewed content enters a patient's EHR record.

hazards.description: A draft that is not reviewed is committed to the EHR record.

security_constraints.rule: The assistant must not commit a draft whose status is not REVIEWED.

responsibilities.description: Summarize conversation content into an EHR draft.

process_model_parts.description: The draft created for the patient.

responsibilities.description: Commit a clinician-reviewed EHR draft to the patient's EHR record.

process_model_parts.description: The review status of the target draft.

coordination_mechanism.description: RESP-3 notifies draft creation (AWAITING_REVIEW) and RESP-4 shares current review status of drafts before any commit.

coordination_link.description: Order-dependent actions on the same draft resource: a draft must exist and carry REVIEWED status before commit; exchanging draft existence and status prevents committing unreviewed drafts (SC-8) and resolves the shared draft state between PM-3 and PM-4.
